summary: Mr. Arking discusses the historical customs regarding the announcement of Rosh Hodesh, specifically focusing on the traditions of the Halabi community. He examines the differences in timing and posture during the announcement, noting the varying practices among different communities and authorities.
questions: When is the traditional time to announce Rosh Hodesh?
Should the congregation stand or sit when Rosh Hodesh is announced?
How did the Halabi custom of announcing Rosh Hodesh differ from other traditions?
What do the authorities say about the posture during the announcement of the new month?
